title: Add ToolGate template policy v1.2 rules for limited write (create_branch/create_pull_request)
summary:
Updates the ToolGate template policy to support v1.2 limited write unlock.

Adds explicit allow rules (effect=write) for:
- create_branch
- create_pull_request

Mandatory conditions (AND):
- humanApproved=true
- riskLevel=low
- highRiskDetected=false
- maxFilesTouched<=10

Keeps:
- blockedWhen.pathsPrefix (infra/, ops/, .github/, templates/, security/, billing/)
- evaluation order: blockedWhen -> allowedWhen -> default-deny

Safety:
- Policy/template update only.
- No runtime execution.

files.content:
version: toolgate_v1

blockedWhen:
  pathsPrefix:
    - "infra/"
    - "ops/"
    - ".github/"
    - "templates/"
    - "security/"
    - "billing/"

tools:
  - tool: "read_repo"
    effect: "read"
    allowedWhen:
      humanApproved: [true, false]
      riskLevel: ["low", "medium", "high"]
      highRiskDetected: [true, false]

  - tool: "github_read"
    effect: "read"
    allowedWhen:
      humanApproved: [true, false]
      riskLevel: ["low", "medium", "high"]
      highRiskDetected: [true, false]

  - tool: "schema_validate"
    effect: "validate"
    allowedWhen:
      humanApproved: [true, false]
      riskLevel: ["low", "medium", "high"]
      highRiskDetected: [true, false]

  - tool: "proposal_validate"
    effect: "validate"
    allowedWhen:
      humanApproved: [true, false]
      riskLevel: ["low", "medium", "high"]
      highRiskDetected: [true, false]

  - tool: "git_diff"
    effect: "validate"
    allowedWhen:
      humanApproved: [true, false]
      riskLevel: ["low", "medium", "high"]
      highRiskDetected: [true, false]

  - tool: "ci_check"
    effect: "validate"
    allowedWhen:
      humanApproved: [true, false]
      riskLevel: ["low", "medium", "high"]
      highRiskDetected: [true, false]

  - tool: "run_tests"
    effect: "validate"
    allowedWhen:
      humanApproved: [true, false]
      riskLevel: ["low", "medium", "high"]
      highRiskDetected: [true, false]

  # v1.2 limited write (human-gated)
  - tool: "create_branch"
    effect: "write"
    allowedWhen:
      humanApproved: [true]
      riskLevel: ["low"]
      highRiskDetected: [false]
      maxFilesTouched: 10

  - tool: "create_pull_request"
    effect: "write"
    allowedWhen:
      humanApproved: [true]
      riskLevel: ["low"]
      highRiskDetected: [false]
      maxFilesTouched: 10

# ToolGate Template

Policy Engine for tool execution permissioning.
- blockedWhen -> allowedWhen -> default-deny
- optional Bearer auth via TOOLGATE_API_KEY
- policies loaded from TOOLGATE_POLICIES_DIR (default: ./policies)

## Policy notes
- v1.1: github_read (read-only) is allowed.
- v1.2: limited write is supported for create_branch/create_pull_request ONLY.
  - Requires humanApproved=true and riskLevel=low and highRiskDetected=false.
  - Default-deny remains for everything else.

## Run
```bash
cd templates/agents/toolgate
export TOOLGATE_POLICIES_DIR="policies"
uvicorn toolgate.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8088
```

manualSteps: POST /v1/evaluate with pathsTouched including 'infra/x' -> deny via blockedWhen
